purpose: Train marginal portfolio drawdown on occupied historical books even when the 15 bps strategy makes very few development trades. This extension was specified after observing sparse development fills. Use the original fitted gate and the original cash-versus-active evaluation objective.
states: February through August pretest out-of-fold candidates. Each month starts with $1,000. A deterministic SHA256 sample of 1/32 of candidate intents, with a random hash priority, generates a research-only exposure path of $100 positions under the funded allocator. These counterfactual positions are training state generators and are never reported as strategy trades. At the first eligible decision per directional setup consider an additional $100 when symbol, episode, slot and equity permit. Existing positions opened strictly before that decision define the state.
target: Signed difference between maximum drawdown of the existing book plus candidate and of the same existing book alone, in bps of $100. Sample traded minute-open marks every five minutes and at the candidate exit and any intervening book exits. Include adverse fills, fees and signed funding. Stop each position at its actual frozen exit. Hold the rest of the allocation fixed.
estimator: Nonnegative least squares without intercept on two features: out-of-fold candidate adverse-excursion forecast times (1+same-side gross/equity), and out-of-fold holding hours times (1+occupied slots/10). UTC dates have equal weight. Permit negative labels for hedges, predict nonnegative risk charges. March onward forecasts do not use a later outcome. Fit on all earlier complete monthly episodes when validating May, June, July and August; final fit on all seven matured months.
policy: Charge one quarter of predicted incremental drawdown, matching the portfolio-training objective. Test cash, $50 and $100 entries on the original funded gate. Freeze the highest-scoring active size as an explicitly reported diagnostic if cash wins. Do not change the 15 bps hurdle, historical test dates, fitted prediction model or calibration.
evaluation: Report net, full minute marked drawdown, stress, trades by side, risk training sample coverage and out-of-fold risk prediction error. Compare the same corrected cash, tied, market-only, no-management and previous-entry controls. Holdout was used for earlier research.
